title: Switching and width truncation commute
statement: Let $n,w\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $\{-1,1\}^n$. Switching its clauses to DNF terms after retaining clauses of width at most $w$ gives the same DNF formula as switching first and then retaining terms of width at most $w$.
